sources.citation: 王辅世 (主编). 1985. 苗语简志. 北京: 民族出版社. pp.104-105 (dialect distribution), pp.106-134 (dialect comparison).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing for any Guiyang variety. p.104 gives only the distribution of the Guiyang subdialect's 西南土语 (~50,000 speakers; Pingba 马场, 马路, 戛云, 白云, 话龙, 昌河; Qingzhen 后六, 芦笙; Anshun 张家屯, 平察, 旧州, 鲍隆, 刘官; Changshun 广顺; Guiyang outskirts). The comparison chapter uses 摆托 (Qingyan, = Northern Guiyang) as the Guiyang point. '重音' absent from the scanned; '轻声' occurs only on p.12, in the 湘西 (腊乙坪) phonology (prefixes read with neutral tone in compounds).

sources.note: Abstracts only. Xiao's thesis abstract explicitly assigns Pingba Huagaolin Miao to the Chuanqiandian subdialect, not Guiyang (so not hmg); Yang 2010 = sound correspondences; Tang 2019 = tone register/phonation of Anshun Dadongkou Miao (subdialect unstated). No abstract mentions 重音/轻声 for a Guiyang variety. Queries 清镇苗语 and 凯洒 returned nothing relevant.
